title: The New Citizens Society Of North China

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
File No... ...H. POLICE
... REGISTRY
SECRET REPORT C.S.6, Special Branch: B.S.Dixon
Date July 25, 1938.

Subject The New Citizens Society (新民会) of North China.

Made by and Forwarded by Inspector Papp.

The New Citizens Society (新民会) in North
China has been organized after the pattern of the Kuomintang
with its headquarters at Peking and branches in almost all
important cities of Northern Provinces. The activities of
this society are similar to those of the Kuomintang under
the Nanking regime. It controls and supervises all public
organizations, newspapers and educational institutions. The
chief aim of this organization is to preach "the doctrine of
the Emperor" or "Hwang Tao" (皇道), and to guide the public
from being misled by communistic and Kuomintang ideas. Its
aims are "to give a new life" to the people of China; Asia
for the Asiatics, and Japan is by Heaven's will the leader of
Asia. Another aim of the Society is to do spy and propaganda
work among educational and religious circles for which purpose
it maintains a secret intelligence network, which functions
mostly along cultural and educational lines.

（印：SHANGHAI MUN. POLICE COMMISSIONER'S OFFICE 25 JULY 1938）

The New Citizens Society has a song which is
required to be sung at all public gatherings as in the case
of the Kuomintang song. The society has also established
schools for the purpose of teaching the young generation of
North China in the spirit of the above principles.

The responsible Chinese leader of this society
is Mr. Miao Ping (缪斌), formerly a Kuomintang official who
was ousted from Nanking on account of corruption.

（批：See D 8017 FILE 28.Q. 257）

The leading officials of the New Citizens Society
are as follows:-
Chairman: Gen. Chang Ching-hui (张景惠), Premier of
Manchukuo.
Vice Chair- Gen. Chang Yen-ching (张燕卿).

秘密报告 C.S.6，特别支部：B.S. Dixon
日期：1938年7月25日。

主题：华北新民会。

由帕普（Papp）巡官撰写并转呈。

华北的新民会仿照国民党模式组建，总部设于北平，在北方各省几乎所有重要城市均设有分支机构。该会的活动与南京政权统治下的国民党活动相似。它控制和监督所有公共组织、报纸和教育机构。该组织的主要宗旨是宣扬“天皇之道”或“皇道”，并引导公众免受共产主义和国民党思想的误导。其目标是“赋予中国人民新生活”；亚洲属于亚洲人，而日本奉天意成为亚洲的领导者。该会的另一目标是在教育和宗教界开展间谍及宣传工作，为此维持着一个秘密情报网络，该网络主要沿文化和教育路线运作。

（印：上海公共租界工部局警务处处长办公室 1938年7月25日）

新民会有一首会歌，规定在所有公共集会上必须演唱，如同国民党党歌一样。该会还建立了学校，旨在以上述原则的精神教导华北的年轻一代。

该会负责的中国领导人是缪斌先生，他曾是国民党官员，因腐败被逐出南京。

（批注：见 D 8017 档案 28.Q. 257）

新民会的主要官员如下：
主席：张景惠将军，满洲国总理。
副主席：张燕卿将军。
